fact: The document states the 5th national population and housing census (RGPH) was enumerated in November to December 2019, counting 20,505,155 residents.
INSD published the key final results (definitive results) of the 5th RGPH in June 2022.
ONI's director general cites the latest census, RGPH 2019, as the population base, giving 12,477,149 inhabitants aged 15 and over.
ONI's Director General cites the latest population and housing census, RGPH 2019, as the source of Burkina Faso's population aged 15 and over (12,477,149).
The abstract cites results of Burkina Faso's 2019 Recensement Général de la Population et de l'Habitation (RGPH), indicating the census was counted in 2019.
The World Bank's World Development Indicators list the Enquête Démographique et de Santé 2021 as Burkina Faso's latest demographic, education or health household survey.
The World Bank's World Development Indicators list the Core Welfare Indicator Questionnaire Survey (CWIQ) of 2014 as the source of Burkina Faso's most recent income and expenditure data.
The World Bank says innovative data collection systems made it possible to estimate the population of conflict-affected areas during Burkina Faso's 2019 population census.
